about: 5 times the course did you dirty: 'I actually didn't realize that the Sahara Desert was in Texas… and of course I'm in there… I thought it was like one of the best drives of my life, and yet now I'm in the sand'; the drive that keeps rolling → 'technically kind of in the fairway / kind of on the cart path, who really knows what that's called' → 'zoinks, that is a tough lie'; full drive → 'seems it actually landed in the cactus' → 'oh I'm scared / aw I got poked / aw I got poked again' → 'we're back in business, I'm just gonna take a drop out here'; 'getting eaten by mosquitoes… wow okay'; ends on 'shot two, I'm a little worried about this tree, so I gotta try to keep it low' → straight into the tree → 'god damn it, well I hit the tree'. Every shot kept whole (tracers to landing), swearing kept, no shirt wipes, no added text, no music, even loudness. Outfits alternate (green pinstripe → white/camo hat → green (cactus day) → orange checker → white/camo hat), never the same shirt back to back. Nothing reused from the other compilations. 47 s (drop the mosquito bit if you want it under 45: 44 s). All cut from your true Dropbox originals. Preview copy here; the real file is full quality.
